name: michael-ning-2023-unoise3-silva138
description: Zhou Lab 16S rRNA gene zOTU processing for the 2009 and 2017 emulsified vegetable oil injections at ORR Area 2 (Michael et al. 2024, Water Research, doi:10.1016/j.watres.2024.121460; ReadMe_EVOinjection2017_16S_v20230222). DNA was extracted from the filters by freeze-grinding (Zhou et al. 1996) and purified with DNeasy PowerSoil kits without bead beating. Amplicons of the V4 region (primers 515F and 806R, two-step PCR, Wu et al. 2015) were sequenced on Illumina MiSeq (500-cycle v2); DNA of the 2009 injection, stored at -80 C, was sequenced in 2014 and that of the 2017 injection in 2018 and 2020. Sequences were processed with USEARCH 11.0.667: demultiplexing, merging pairs with at most 10 mismatches and at least 80% alignment, primer trimming without mismatch, quality filtering with at most 1 expected error and at least 100 bases. UNOISE3 generated the zOTU table. For samples with several filters, one sample was generated by resampling each zOTU table weighted by the DNA amount of each extraction (emr_combine_resample.r). Taxonomy was assigned by the RDP naive Bayesian classifier (assignTaxonomy in DADA2) against SILVA 138. Chloroplast and mitochondrial sequences were removed and every sample was rarefied to 10,448 reads (processed zOTU table). The lab also built a FastTree tree of the representative sequences (20230222.zOTU.tree.nwk), which is not in CORAL.
